about_the_game:
Deathrun is a fun and exciting multiplayer game where you race through obstacle-filled courses in a battle-royale-style challenge! In this dynamic, cartoonish game, you must overcome deadly traps, dodge hazards, and outrun your opponents to be the last one standing!

Built on Unreal Engine 5, Deathrun offers smooth animations and a vibrant visual style. With P2P network architecture, you can compete with friends and players worldwide, enjoying fast and stable matches.

Dive into wild challenges, customize your character with a variety of outfits and accessories, and prove that you have what it takes to become the champion!

Game Features:

  • Cartoonish graphics on Unreal Engine 5: A bright and stylish visual world where every challenge looks amazing.

  • P2P multiplayer: Engage in low-latency matches no matter where you or your opponents are.

  • Character customization: Create your own unique look with tons of costume and accessory options.

  • Exciting levels: Each arena is full of dynamic traps that will keep you on edge from start to finish.

  • Regular updates: New levels, game modes, and cosmetic items are constantly added.

Ready to race through deadly obstacles and become the best of the best? Join us in Deathrun and show what you’re made of!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
